_howToEdit: THIS IS THE ONLY FILE YOU NEED TO EDIT for prices, packages, and the contact email. Change a number or a sentence, save, refresh the site. Do not edit the HTML for a price change. price is a number: 125 means $125. Live menu (24 Oct 2026): One Skill Session $125 / Core 3 $350 / Full Basics Package $595.

brand.name: My First Wrench
brand.tagline: Driveway car lessons. Anyone of any age can learn.

notes.partsExtra: Parts and fluids are extra - you buy them, or I bill at cost. A parent can watch. If you are the one learning, you are welcome too.
notes.partsFine: Parts and fluids are not included in the lesson price. You buy them ahead of time, or I bill them to you at exact cost.

otherServices.title: Dirt bikes, four-wheelers, and jobs not listed
otherServices.body: Cars are the main lessons. Dirt bikes and four-wheelers count too. If it has oil, tires, and a talent for stranding somebody in a field, message me. If I can teach it on your machine, we will figure it out.

packages.name: One Skill Session
packages.summary: Oil, tires, or brakes. Pick one. Pick the job that you are least familiar with. I will make sure you are confident in yourself for the next time. Anyone of any age can learn.
packages.hero: One focused lesson. Oil, tires, or brakes. Pick one.
includes: Pick one skill: oil and filter, spare tire / tire change, or brake pads on one axle
On your vehicle, in your driveway
The student turns the wrenches. I hold the flashlight and teach.

packages.name: Core 3
packages.summary: Oil + tires + brakes. The three things that leave a driver stranded on the shoulder looking around for someone to come help. After this, you are the person people call for help. $25 less than booking those three as One Skill Sessions.
packages.hero: Oil, tires, and brakes. The set every driver should know.
includes: Oil + tires + brake pads on two wheels (front or rear)
Split across visits if one Saturday is not enough
Brake day is the long one - already in the $350
$25 less than three separate One Skill Sessions

packages.name: Full Basics Package
packages.summary: Core 3 (oil, tires, brakes), then rotors, then pick two more lessons. A solid set before a lot of solo driving - for a new driver, or for you.
packages.hero: Core 3 (oil, tires, brakes) + rotors + two extras you pick.
includes: Core 3, plus rotors - oil, tires, and one-axle brakes included
Two extras you pick: headlights / taillights, spark plugs / coil packs, fluids checks, air / cabin filters.
Best before school season starts, a new job, or a roadtrip.

draftPosts.body:
I'll teach you to work on your own car. Driveway, your tools or mine, you turn the wrenches. Anyone of any age can learn.

One Skill Session $125 (oil, tires, or brakes - pick one). Core 3 $350. Full Basics Package $595.
